args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions — the rollback completed all regions and was verified as rolled out.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 release, the elevated error rate, and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unresolved — the incident remains open for investigation.
